text:
maria: quick heads-up — curl example on /docs/runtime/pagination is returning a 500 for me when using the sample request. tried on staging and prod.
sam: can you paste the exact curl you used?
maria: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v0/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
response: `{"error":"internal server error"}`
ryan: looks like the example is pointing at /v0/generate (old). runtime switched to /v1/generate in the last model deploy, so snippet needs updating.
docs-bot: link-checker flagged /docs/runtime/pagination -> 500 (rule: example-endpoint-200)
maria: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — updates snippet, and adds a quick redirect from /docs/runtime/pagination-old to the new slug.
maria: also, checked CODEOWNERS for that folder and it's empty. @jen can you take docs ownership so we don't miss regressions?
jen: I can own it. will add `docs/runtime/ @jen` to CODEOWNERS and queue the PR review.
alex: fyi runtime eng will be in the APAC maintenance window Thurs 02:00-04:00 UTC — if you need infra help for a hotfix around then, ping me early.
sam: small ask for the PR — please ensure the snippet shows the correct auth header. should we show `Key $API_KEY` or `Bearer`? external blog still references the old example.
ryan: use `-H "Authorization: Key $API_KEY"` — that's what the runtime gateway expects for API keys.
maria: updated the PR with that header and a short note about the redirect/source-of-truth. also added a test curl call in the docs CI that hits staging.
docs-bot: CI check: docs-snippets -> passed on staging.
jen: leaving a couple of tiny nits in the review (typo and a missing alt on an image). will merge after CI is green.
maria: thanks! once merged can someone trigger the staging redeploy?
jen: I'll merge + trigger.
docs-bot: staging deploy succeeded and link-checker passed.
alex: verified staging endpoint returns 200 for the sample.
maria: closing loop — I'll backfill the changelog entry and add a short note in the runtime sprint board. appreciate the quick turn. :tada:
